name: Lomax Boyd
abstract_title: Views Toward Consciousness Shape Moral and Epistemic Attitudes Toward Synthetic Biological Intelligence
abstract: Rapid advances in neuromorphic technology are laying the foundation for engineering synthetic biological intelligence. These ‘biocomputers’ are composed of biological and in silico components with the potential to expand our understanding of cognition. Yet biocomputers raise ethical and moral questions, such as whether possession of cognitive traits, such as consciousness, confers moral status to engineered systems.
